description: Real-time quote for 1-200 A-share securities (last price, volume, change %, bid/ask). For >200 codes use `scan`. HK codes are not supported; for an A+H company use the A-share canonical (SSE:601398, not HK:01398). Rows also carry `turnover_rate` (percent), `same_minute_volume_ratio` (cumulative shares through the snapshot minute divided by the five-session same-minute cumulative-share average; null if missing; not comparable to market turnover `volume_ratio`), `fundflow_latest` {trade_date, bar_time, main_net_cum, super_net_cum} (latest stored minute cumulative CNY; check its date/time), `industry` (Shenwan L1/L2), `top_concept` (strongest member concept now) and, for margin-list names, a T+1 `margin` block. Expect `industry` / `top_concept` to be absent on many rows — coverage, not failure: `top_concept` resolves for only a subset of A-shares and `industry` does not cover 北交所 (`BSE:*`). `top_concept` is **not** the limit-up LLM `leading_concept`, which is not served here. Live rows also expose `top_base_concept` `{id,name,kind:base,pct_change}` and `top_concept_status` / `top_base_concept_status` (ready, no_membership, no_snapshot, unavailable). The two layers rank independently; use kind=base for base detail. Historical rows carry neither current theme field nor their statuses. **In `pre_open` / `auction` sessions read the `auction` block `{status, prev_close, price, pct_change, volume, amount}`, not top-level `price` / `pct_change`.** `status` is `not_started` / `matched` / `no_match`; a top-level `pct_change` of 0 in that window is ambiguous — only `auction.status = matched` with `auction.pct_change = 0` is a flat auction. 盘前顶层 prev_close 与 auction.prev_close 对齐为今日基准，prev_close_date 为上一交易日；previous_close 为昨日实际收盘价。prev_close_basis 区分交易所参考价、事件调整价与未校准昨收，prev_close_provisional=true 时不可视为已确认除权参考价。未撮合的顶层 price 仅为基准展示，pct_change 为 null。 Suspended / frozen names report `no_match`; `auction.volume` / `amount` stay null until the 09:25 match (volume in shares). Read `market_trade_date`, not `snapshot_at`, to tell whether a row is today's. Unknown codes are omitted; known-but-unmatched codes come back with null prices. super_net_in 为最新已存分钟累计超大单净流入（元），时间与 fundflow_latest 相同。 `main_net_in` = current-day cumulative main-capital net inflow (CNY; `main_net_in_stale` = fallback layer, not necessarily previous-day data; check fundflow_latest.trade_date/bar_time; null for `BSE:*`). 竞价未匹配量 unmatched 为股，正买负卖；unmatched_as_of 是最后有效竞价观测的源时间（09:25 后冻结），历史未采集为 null。

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

include_l2.description: Include L2 5-level order book (requires quote:l2 scope)

name: quote
